The following events took place in '''53 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Xanatos]] leaves the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] after [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] is forced to kill the boy's father, [[Crion]], on [[Telos IV]].<ref name="Apprentice:Rival" />
*The opera, ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', leaves [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to tour the Galaxy.
*[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] attends [[Mirnic University]].
*[[Nirama]] wins control of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] [[Organization|criminal organization]] from [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
*Latest possible date for the establishment of [[Corulag Academy]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Jedi Emergency">''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]'', it is stated that at least two decades have passed since the establishment of Corulag Academy</ref>.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' mentions that Nirama gained control of Riboga's organization 21 years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. It can therefore Nirama gained control of the organization in 53 BBY.
